review_text: The best greeting app in the entire game store. Great selection and they can be uploaded to photos, which most apps will not do!!! That's the reason I keep installing on every new device AND tell my friends. Selection is very good, nice colors and print! Outstanding job developers. Keep adding more great wishes!! I commend your hard work and attention to detail!
This is a very good app if you got someone you want to send a card to it has a very big selection an I recommend it thank you developer
This is my 'go to' application when I want to express myself in a special way.

I like your stuff loads to choose from all different sediments from quirky to cute to funny perhaps maybe more funny ones!
